This week, in addition to unveiling the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo, Apple also launched a brand-new iPhone wrist strap accessory. Here are the details.

Apple's new wrist strap accessory can be used with iPhone cases and AirPods Pro

Apple continues to expand its iPhone accessory lineup with new additions.

In addition to a series of all-new cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo, the company has also introduced a brand-new wrist strap accessory.

This strap is designed to pair with select Apple iPhone cases and AirPods Pro, making it easy for users to carry their devices hands-free. The strap is carefully woven from 100% recycled PET yarn for a comfortable fit that can be worn all day without issue. Built-in flexible magnets keep the strap lying flat and neatly in place.

The strap measures 15.4 inches long and is compatible with most official Apple cases designed for the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and iPhone 17 series.

Available colours include wine red, bright blue, olive green, taupe, magenta, and black.

This new accessory can be considered a fairly straightforward addition to Apple's accessory lineup. With this brand-new strap attached, your iPhone and/or AirPods Pro can be comfortably and securely fastened to your wrist, providing better protection.

You can order Apple's wrist strap on Amazon for US$29.

For years, third-party accessory makers have offered similar products, but it's certainly pleasing to see an official Apple version finally make its debut.

Are you planning to order a wrist strap for your iPhone or AirPods? Feel free to share in the comments.
